messages:
sara: Heads up — large latency spike in us-west-2 for generation routes starting ~12:14 UTC. p50 jumped ~120ms -> ~600ms, p95 ~2.2s. Embeddings mostly fine.

sara: Looks correlated with the runtime v1.3.7 rollout at 12:10 (deploy-bot posted).

deploy-bot: deploy v1.3.7 to us-west-2 started by chris at 12:09:43 UTC

chris: I shipped a batching/kv-cache tweak (PR #482) that adjusts continuous batching window and changes prefix-KV eviction timing. Rolling in canaries at 12:08.

maria: can we confirm metrics — is this batching causing larger queuing or slower KV lookups?

tim: Adding logs — sample request latencies from frontends: 
```
2024-10-05T12:12:58Z GET /v1/generate 125ms
2024-10-05T12:14:20Z POST /v1/generate 610ms
2024-10-05T12:15:03Z POST /v1/generate 2.1s
```

anya: tagging @chris @oncall-sre — if batching window increased, peak concurrency could be creating bigger batches and stalling KV cache misses. Quick mitigation: reduce batch size and disable continuous-batching on affected pools.

oncall-sre: Agreed. Two quick mitigations we can try in parallel: 1) revert runtime to v1.3.6 canary -> rollback 2) change routing to shift 30% traffic to us-east-1 and spin up extra instances in us-west-2 dedicated pool. Which do we prefer first?

chris: I'll roll back the runtime canary immediately (start rollback now). If rollback doesn't help within 5m, we'll throttle batching and shift traffic.

maria: Also consider evicting stale prefix-KV entries — I saw growth in cache eviction latency in metrics. Clearing cold prefixes may speed lookups.

tim: Running admin commands to lower batch size on the generation pools:
```
# reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 16
curl -X POST "https://infra-admin.internal/api/pools/generation/update" -d '{"max_batch_size":16}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer *****'
```

anya: I can run the KV purge script on the pool with caution (will drop cache hit-rate temporarily).

infra-bot: autoscaler triggered additional nodes in us-west-2: +6 gpus at 12:16 UTC, scaling group "gen-w2".

chris: rollback initiated (v1.3.6). Noting this will briefly route some canaries to older runtime.

deploy-bot: rollback completed: v1.3.6 active in us-west-2 at 12:18:34 UTC (triggered by chris).

sara: after rollback p95 dropped to ~450ms within a minute, p50 ~130ms. Looks like rollback helped.

maria: good sign. We'll still run the KV purge and keep batch size reduced for 30m to ensure stability.

anya: KV purge scheduled and running now — monitoring hit-rate. Expect temporary increase in upstream calls.

tim: Confirmed the admin patch applied, max_batch_size = 16 on generation pools.

oncall-sre: Routing: shifted 25% traffic to us-east-1 while autoscaler finishes. Latency in us-east-1 is stable.

chris: We'll open a postmortem and revert the PR until we validate the batching algorithm under high-var load. Assigning follow-up: ENG-RUNTIME-#927.

sara: thanks everyone — callout: cost for extra scaling ~ +$2.3k for the hour (estimate). Add to incident notes.

maria: I'll capture graphs and make an alert to flag similar KV eviction lag increases earlier.

oncall-sre: Closing the immediate incident — keep monitoring for next 2h and report any regressions.

chris: PR #482 reverted. We'll rework batching & KV TTL logic and test on synthetic loadbed before re-rolling.

sara: filing follow-up ticket for postmortem + action items. :white_check_mark:
